punchline: When his general rebelled, Marcus Aurelius told his troops to capture him alive, and after the man was killed he forgave the conspirators.
thirty_sec: Marcus Aurelius, sick and possibly dying, heard that his most trusted general, Avidius Cassius, had declared himself Caesar in Syria. He kept the news from his troops and waited. When Cassius did not back down, Marcus marched against him but wanted him captured, not killed. A lone assassin killed Cassius, and Marcus refused to execute any coconspirators. For Ryan Holiday it shows the obstacle becoming the way.
